messages:
maya: PTAL — addressed the comments on the batching path and pushed fixes for the allocator nil panic. added unit test and changelog entry. branch: feature/kv-allocator-fix. CI rerunning.

alex: Thanks — quick skim looks good. can you split the big test into two smaller cases? makes flakes easier to bisect. also please add a short release-note blurb.

maya: split tests and added release-note (under docs/release-notes). also added a comment explaining the O(n^2) edge case we discussed. PTAL again. if this passes we should merge into the next canary window.

kevin: I'll take a look in ~30m. heads-up: i'm on call later so can't cut the canary after 17:00 PT. if approvals land by 16:30 we're good.

alex: left one tiny inline nit about comment wording. otherwise LGTM. :+1:

maya: nit fixed and pushed. re-requesting review. added the needs-canary label so ops knows.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled for 2026-03-18 16:00-17:00 UTC; capacity checks passed.

kevin: LGTM, approving now. please squash into a single commit with message: "kv allocator: fix nil panic + tests" before merging. do NOT use skip-ci here (we need full run).

maya: squashed and force-pushed. CI passed locally; GH retried one flaky integration and it passed on re-run. merging once the auto-checks finish. pinging @oncall for post-deploy watch.

natalie: tiny follow-up suggestion — note in docs that this change may add ~2ms tail latency in the worst-case; we should file a perf follow-up to investigate. i'll open that PR after merge. :eyes:

maya: noted, will open a follow-up for the perf investigation. thanks everyone — merging after final CI. :tada:
